title: senna tora var. obtusifolia
intro: Senna tora var. obtusifolia, commonly known as Indian senna or kashmi senna, is a plant species belonging to the Fabaceae family. It is known for its laxative properties, and has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, including constipation, digestive problems, and skin conditions. The plant's health benefits are attributed to its ability to stimulate bowel movements, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant activity. The bioactive constituents of Senna tora var. obtusifolia include anthraquinone glycosides, such as aloe-emodin, chrysophanol, and rhein, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, including purgation, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial effects.
